title: Community mappings fallback integrated into node_mappings pipeline
description:
Problem
Common workflow nodes (e.g., SetNode/GetNode) are still missing from generated `data/node_mappings.json`, which forces repeated per-workflow `custom_node_map` entries in comfygit core.

Current state (verified)
- Pipeline order is: cache build -> mapping build -> manager augmentation -> save (`src/update_registry.py:54-67`, `src/update_registry.py:177-196`).
- Augmentation currently reads only Manager data and has no curated local fallback source (`src/augment_mappings.py:58-74`, `src/augment_mappings.py:129-266`).
- Current snapshot does not contain `SetNode::_` or `GetNode::_` in mappings.

Target state
- Add a curated community mappings input in this repo and merge it into final `node_mappings.json` during build.
- Merge behavior is fallback-only: add entries only when the key is still missing after registry+manager processing.
- Keep comfygit-core resolver unchanged for this feature (data-layer fix).

Affected files (planned)
- `config/community_mappings.json` (new curated source)
- `src/augment_mappings.py` (merge implementation)
- `src/update_registry.py` (pipeline wiring)
- `tests/integration/...` (new/updated coverage)
- `README.md` and/or `src/README_REGISTRY.md` (maintenance workflow docs)

Out of scope
- No new resolver priority/stage in comfygit core.
- No API lookup behavior changes in comfygit core.

Acceptance criteria
- Built output includes seeded community fallback entries (initially SetNode/GetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes).
- Existing registry or manager mapping rows are never overwritten by community fallback.
- Merge is deterministic and schema-compliant.
- Missing package references in community mappings fail with a clear validation error.
- Tests cover insertion, precedence/no-overwrite, and error path.

Execution phases
- Phase 1: `crd-90m.1`
- Phase 2: `crd-90m.2`
- Phase 3 (parallel): `crd-90m.3` and `crd-90m.4`

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Supersession note: closed prior override track (crd-9rt, crd-9rt.1, crd-9rt.2) in favor of this pipeline-integrated community mappings approach.

title: Add curated community mappings source file and initial seed entries
description:
Goal
Create the curated community mappings source file with initial seed entries.

title: Integrate community fallback merge into registry-data build pipeline
description:
Goal
Integrate community fallback merge into the existing build pipeline.

Current state
- `MappingsAugmenter` only merges Manager-derived data (`src/augment_mappings.py:129-266`).
- Orchestrator only wires mappings + manager files (`src/update_registry.py:29-33`, `src/update_registry.py:191-196`).

Target state
- Add a merge step for `config/community_mappings.json` in the augmentation flow.
- Apply community entries only when a node key is still unresolved after registry+manager augmentation.
- Preserve existing rows/ranks for keys that already exist.
- Validate referenced package IDs exist in `packages`; fail loudly with clear message if missing.

File touchpoints
- WRITE: `src/augment_mappings.py`
- WRITE: `src/update_registry.py`
- READ: `config/community_mappings.json`
- READ: `config/output_schema.toml`

Can run in parallel with
- None (core implementation task)

Conflicts
- Requires `crd-90m.1` output schema/file.
- Unblocks `crd-90m.3` and `crd-90m.4`.

Acceptance criteria
- Running augmentation with a community file inserts fallback rows only for missing keys.
- Existing registry/manager keys are untouched.
- Missing package reference in community file raises clear, actionable error.
- Output remains schema-compatible with current loader expectations.

title: Add tests for community fallback precedence and seeded Set/Get behavior
description:
Goal
Add automated test coverage for community fallback behavior.

Current state
- Existing tests cover registry ranking and manager augmentation, but not curated community fallback.

Target state
- Add integration tests for:
  1) fallback insertion when key is missing,
  2) no overwrite when key exists from registry,
  3) no overwrite when key exists from manager,
  4) invalid community package reference fails clearly.
- Include explicit SetNode/GetNode seeded behavior assertion.

File touchpoints
- WRITE: `tests/integration/test_community_mappings_fallback.py` (preferred) or existing augmentation integration test module
- READ: `tests/integration/conftest.py`
- READ: `src/augment_mappings.py`

Can run in parallel with
- `crd-90m.4` after `crd-90m.2` is complete.

Conflicts
- Depends on `crd-90m.1` and `crd-90m.2` for schema + implementation behavior.

Acceptance criteria
- Tests fail before implementation and pass after implementation.
- Tests verify precedence/no-overwrite rules and seeded SetNode/GetNode mapping behavior.
- Test suite remains fast and deterministic.

title: Document operational workflow for community mappings maintenance
description:
Goal
Document maintenance workflow for community mappings.

Current state
- Repo docs describe community/manager augmentation at a high level, but not curated fallback authoring/validation flow.

Target state
- Add contributor-facing docs for community mappings lifecycle:
  - where file lives,
  - expected schema fields,
  - review criteria (fallback-only intent),
  - validation/test commands,
  - how daily pipeline consumes it.
- Clarify this is a blind-spot fallback layer, not a replacement for registry/manager data.

File touchpoints
- WRITE: `README.md`
- WRITE (optional): `src/README_REGISTRY.md`
- READ: `config/community_mappings.json`
- READ: `src/update_registry.py` and `src/augment_mappings.py`

Can run in parallel with
- `crd-90m.3` after `crd-90m.2` is complete.

Conflicts
- Depends on `crd-90m.1` + `crd-90m.2` so docs match implemented behavior.

Acceptance criteria
- Docs clearly describe authoring + validation workflow for community mappings.
- Docs include concrete examples for SetNode/GetNode mapping entries.
- Docs match actual implementation paths and command flow.

title: Global Node Override Mappings
description: Add a curated node_overrides.json file for mapping nodes that can't be auto-resolved by the registry pipeline. Primary use case: frontend-only JavaScript nodes (like SetNode/GetNode from KJNodes) that are invisible to the backend-scraping pipeline. The overrides file is consumed by comfygit-core's GlobalNodeResolver as a fallback between properties lookup and the main registry mapping table. Format: { "node_type": { "package_id": "...", "reason": "...", "source_url": "..." } }. Should be versioned alongside node_mappings.json and fetched by the same data manager.
close_reason: Superseded by crd-90m (community mappings merged into node_mappings pipeline)

title: Create node_overrides.json with initial JS-only node mappings
description: Create data/node_overrides.json alongside existing node_mappings.json. Initial entries: SetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes, GetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes. Schema: { "version": "...", "overrides": { "NodeType": { "package_id": "...", "reason": "js-only-virtual-node", "source_url": "https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes" } } }. Include metadata for each override (reason, source URL, date added). Update README with format docs and contribution guidelines.

title: Include node_overrides.json in GitHub release artifacts
description: Update the GitHub Actions publish workflow to include node_overrides.json as a release artifact alongside node_mappings.json. Ensure the data manager in comfygit-core can fetch it from the same release URL pattern.
